productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: Join Willa and her loyal friend Woof in this collection of eight adventures! Join Willa and her trusty dog Woof in a heartwarming and humorous series full of adventure, imagination, and loads of fun! From school camp mysteries to planning the perfect Grandparents’ Day, Willa navigates life with the help of her best old-age friend Frank, her best same-age friend Tae, and her loyal four-legged companion Woof. Whether she's tackling a bully, organizing a Tournament of the Ages, or turning everyone into happy campers, Willa’s creative ideas and big heart always save the day. Perfect for young listeners who love stories of friendship, problem-solving, and endless fun. Tracks included: Introduction Dedication Preface Willa & Woof 1: Mimi is Missing Chapter 1: Woof Chapter 2: A Secret Chapter 3: The Plan Chapter 4: Seeds of Hope Chapter 5: Too Many Birds Chapter 6: Help is on Hand Chapter 7: Where's Frank? Chapter 8: A New Idea Chapter 9: Have You Seen This Pigeon? Creators are independent audio makers bringing their original stories, games, songs and more to Yoto Cards. We hand-pick the best and freshest ideas — so every Creators Card meets the Yoto gold standard.

[Explore the Creators Collection](/creators/)
